title: General paralysis of the insane!
html_source:
A twist on the acronym previously mentioned g.p.i., “general paralysis of the insane”

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Hamlet could be said to have this condition as well – ‘paralysis’ referring to Hamlet’s inability to do anything quickly or decisively (at least early in the play) and ‘insane’ referring to Hamlet, well, being Hamlet.
